description: This Java source file defines an interface for a live command related to retrieving 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends other command interfaces, provides accessor methods for thing identifiers, and includes deprecated methods for backward compatibility.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommand
classes.description: Interface representing a live command to retrieve 'things' with various accessors, extending command and query interfaces, and providing default methods.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Deprecated method returning list of thing IDs as strings; calls getThingEntityIds() and converts each ThingId to its string representation.

methods.name: getThingEntityIds
methods.description: Returns a list of ThingId objects representing the identifiers of 'things' to be retrieved.
